Maple Grove Townhomes - 3 Bed / 2.5 Bath Townhouse
412 Maple Grove Ln, Redwood City, CA 94061
Rent $2,350/mo (reduced to $2,295). 1,450 sqft. Fenced patio and yard. Walk to Hoover Elementary (0.4 mi).
Security deposit $2,350, last month's rent due at signing. Application fee $45 per adult. Pet screening fee $25 per pet.
Dogs welcome, up to 2 pets, 75 lb weight limit, breed restrictions apply. Pet fee $350 non-refundable, pet rent $40/mo per pet.
Tenant pays electric and gas; typical bills for the unit about $165. Water, sewer, trash included.
Attached 1-car garage included. Washer/dryer hookups. Dishwasher. Available Jan 5.
